# @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.6.8

Refactor release for DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`.

## Changed

- Restored the enhanced Automation tasks UI: card layout, search, Active/All/Inactive counters, Today/Overdue/Recurring filters, Date/Dialog grouping and per-card actions.
- Removed the plugin's copied Rules editor and copied Delivery records implementation.
- Removed the temporary native-page DOM enhancer and its MutationObserver path.
- The plugin now captures DSH's shipped `main:schedules` registration before shadowing it and reuses the real `TaskManagerPage` component/actions as a native detail bridge.
- Edit and History stay on the enhanced Scheduler page and open the native DSH Rules / Delivery records detail on the right.
- Native date/time pickers, validation, save flow, deletion flow and delivery-history rendering come from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-schedule`.
- Delivery popup, unread attention, overdue warning and sidebar summary remain unchanged.

## Tests

- Added a native-detail bridge contract covering native component capture, injected actions, task selection and Rules/Delivery records routing.
- Removed tests for the deleted custom editor and the obsolete native-page MutationObserver enhancer.
- CI still runs package tests, bundle determinism, npm pack validation and DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 install/boot smoke.
